messages:
sam: FYI found AWS access key id (AKIA...) hard-coded in a CI build log that ended up baked into an image pushed to prod-registry. tagging @maya @leon for rotation + image block. @rita please sweep clusters.

maya: on it. i'll disable keys and create replacements. will push new creds to Vault and rotate consumers.

leon: can you share the image digest and registry path so i can quarantine? also adding a CI check to strip /tmp/build-logs from images.

sam: registry=eu1.registry.redwood.com/agent-builder:sha256:aa11bb22cc, log path inside image=/tmp/build-logs/output.log. build user was iam user agent-ci.

rita: running quick grep across nodes. command: ```kubectl get pods -A -o json | jq -r '.items[] | "\(.metadata.namespace)/\(.metadata.name)"' | xargs -I {} sh -c "kubectl exec -n $(echo {} | cut -d/ -f1) $(echo {} | cut -d/ -f2) -- cat /tmp/build-logs/output.log 2>/dev/null | grep -E 'AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}' || true"``` posting hits shortly.

ash: adding temporary IAM deny for agent-ci user and creating CloudWatch metric filter to detect any use of the compromised key.

sec-bot: secret-scan alert: pattern 'AKIA' found in image sha256:aa11bb22cc. severity=high. incident SEC-4012 opened.

oncall-sre: i'm awake. coordinating with cloud infra to deactivate keys and check CloudTrail. ETA 12m. please give list of images to quarantine.

maya: flow i'll run: 1) aws iam list-access-keys --user-name agent-ci 2) aws iam update-access-key --access-key-id <id> --status Inactive --user-name agent-ci 3) create new keypair and write to Vault at secret/data/ci/agent. then rotate deploy tokens that reference it. will also revoke sessions via sts revoke-session for any active creds.

maya: note: will also rewrap any Vault transit ciphertexts encrypted with the old KMS key binding (we rotate KMS wrapping keys monthly but will force rewrap for affected secrets). sample vault command: ```vault write transit/rewrap ciphertext=@old.enc``` adjust path.

leon: blocked the digest in our registry policy and added quarantine tag. rolling a new image build with redacted logs now. CI guardrail: fail if tar contains /tmp/build-logs.

rita: cluster sweep: 2 hits in staging (sha256:cc33dd44ee) and one dev image (sha256:dd55ee66ff). all flagged and quarantined.

ash: deny policy applied to agent-ci user. creating a short-lived condition on the role to force MFA for new keys. also instrumenting a KMS key usage alert.

oncall-sre: CloudTrail shows one failed API attempt from the exposed key, no successful operations. continuing watch, set up alert for any s3:PutObject or iam:* calls.

sam: post-containment checklist: 1) postmortem assigned to me 2) CI change to scrub build logs and block artifacts (leon) 3) update Vault audit logging + rewrap path retention (maya/sre) 4) org note about never baking logs into images (ash). please DM when each done.

sec-bot: SEC-4012 status -> contained. monitoring enabled.

maya: rotation completed and new credentials written into Vault path secret/data/ci/agent. image rebuilt and deployed to canary (sha256:ff77aa88).

leon: CI guardrail merged into pipeline, new builds fail on /tmp/build-logs. blocked older images via registry policy.

rita: final sweep returned no further matches.

ash: added CloudWatch alarms and KMS usage alert; also filed a follow-up to tighten builder role permissions (SEC-4020).

sam: thanks all. i'll publish postmortem tomorrow and ensure audit log retention increased to 90 days for Vault-transit and KMS logs. closing thread in 24h after no anomalies. :white_check_mark:
